Name: JP's The Resourcer - Resource Buildings
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]
[center][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]The Resourcer[/u][/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]The industrial revolution has come to the valley, and this time no one can complain because you were the one who did all the manual labor and harvesting![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=3]This mod adds 3 new buildings that produce different resources depending on their level and probabilities, which increase with each upgrade level. 
All of them can be built in Robin's shop and, obviously, upgraded there. [color=#ffff00][b]You can only build one building of each type at a time (for example, if you build a sawmill, you will have to upgrade it to the maximum level before you can build a second one).[/b][/color] [b]Each type of building can be built up to a maximum of three times. [/b][/size]


[b][size=4][color=#00ff00]Production for each building occurs every 20 minutes of game time and continues throughout the night. Multiple resources can be generated at the same time.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]Reference size (tiles occupied) of a Barn: 7x4. [/color][/size][/b]


[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]The Quarry[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[size=3]An automated building for mining resources. A maximum of [/size][b]3 quarries[/b][size=3] per farm is allowed, and you must upgrade your current one to the maximum level (12) before you can build the next one. [/size][b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Size: 7x3[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Global Mineral Rule:[/b] Each cycle has a base probability of [b]0.2%[/b] (multiplied by the building's level) to generate a random rare mineral.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
